.. change::
    :tags: usecase, postgresql, reflection
    :tickets: 13577

    PostgreSQL index reflection now reports invalid indexes with
    ``postgresql_invalid=True`` in the Inspector's ``dialect_options``.
    Reflected :class:`.Index` objects expose this state in a separate,
    read-only ``index.dialect_options["postgresql"].reflected`` mapping.
    The new ``REFLECTED_ONLY`` marker, available to any construct that uses
    :attr:`.DefaultDialect.construct_arguments`, keeps these values out of
    DDL options and out of :attr:`.Index.dialect_kwargs`, while
    constructors continue to accept them for compatibility with consumers
    of Inspector results.

    .. seealso::

        :ref:`postgresql_invalid_index_reflection`
